name: 川东大数据中心 (Chuandong / East Sichuan Big Data Center)
developer: China Telecom Sichuan / Dazhou municipal partners
notes: Dazhou municipal article says the center is open and operating with Sugon, Alibaba Cloud, Baidu data labeling and others signed; Xinhua/CNFIN reported Nov. 2022 opening, total investment RMB1bn, 60 mu site, 800 phase-1 racks and 3,000 phase-2 planned racks, PUE under 1.25, 32T egress bandwidth.

name: Dazhou city internal data-center node under Chengdu-Chongqing/Tianfu cluster
developer: Dazhou municipal government / Sichuan provincial digital infrastructure program
notes: Cover News says Dazhou is one of five Sichuan cities, and the only one in northeast Sichuan, allowed to build around 3,000 standard-rack city internal data centers; municipal article links Dazhou to the national integrated computing network / East Data West Computing layout.

name: 云上天府智算中心 (Cloud Tianfu Intelligent Computing Center)
developer: Sichuan Cloud Tianfu Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Located in Deyang's Tianfu Data Valley / Cloud Tianfu Big Data Industrial Park. Sichuan Online reported formal operation on 2023-09-26; designed to national Grade A standard, single building over 50,000 sqm, 6,120 cabinets averaging 6 kW and up to 100,000 servers. Capacity_mw calculated from 6,120 x 6 kW IT rack capability.

name: 得荣县水电消纳产业园互联网大数据中心项目 (Derong Hydropower Consumption Industrial Park Internet Big Data Center)
developer: Ganzi Jingbo Network Technology Co., Ltd. / Huawei-related project reporting
notes: OFweek reported project start with RMB570m investment; planned total building area 76,400 sqm. Phase 1 includes one IDC building and power center over about 18,387 sqm; phase 2 includes two additional IDC buildings and two power centers.

name: 甘孜州能源大数据中心 (Ganzi Prefecture Energy Big Data Center)
developer: State Grid Ganzi Power Supply Company / Ganzi prefectural energy-data program
notes: People's Daily/Sichuan Online reported the center was formally established in Kangding on 2022-03-22 to support energy monitoring, carbon and clean-energy data products; sector-specific data center rather than commercial colocation.

name: 甘孜州绿色智算舱项目 (Ganzi Green Intelligent Computing Cabin Pilot)
developer: China Telecom Sichuan / Ganzi prefecture partners
notes: Ganzi TV reported Sichuan Telecom's 2024 pilot in Kongyu Township, Kangding: containerized compute servers with power distribution and environmental monitoring, described as Sichuan's first green-power distributed intelligent-computing cabin pilot.

name: 广元市云计算大数据中心 / 川北云计算大数据中心
developer: Guangyuan municipal government / China Telecom Sichuan / 21Vianet
notes: Initial city-cloud project was signed/launched by Guangyuan and China Telecom Sichuan in 2017. Sichuan Online later listed Guangyuan/川北 as one of China Telecom Sichuan's Yun Jin Tianfu eight big-data-center projects already in operation.

name: 联通IDC大数据中心 (Leshan Unicom IDC Big Data Center)
notes: Leshan government-service / high-tech-zone article describes an enterprise research visit to the Unicom IDC Big Data Center, indicating an operating IDC/data-center facility in Leshan.

name: 乐山宝德未来科技城云计算数据中心 (Leshan Baode Future Tech City Cloud Computing Data Center)
developer: Leshan Baode Future City Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Data Center Systems & Engineering reported the cloud-computing data center was nearing completion; phase 1 IDC big-data center has two three-story buildings with 5,000 sqm per floor and planned 3,000 cabinets.

name: 峨边核桃坪产业园人工智能算力基础设施项目
developer: Leshan municipal / Ebian industrial-park AI project investors
notes: Sichuan Online reported three newly signed AI computing-infrastructure projects in Leshan; two computing centers are to land in Ebian's Hetaoping Industrial Park, later forming nearly 10,000P high-performance computing facilities plus at least 10 edge-computing data containers.

name: 珑腾凉山州AI数据中心项目 (Longteng Liangshan AI Data Center)
developer: 盐腾数据 / 珑腾数据-related project company
notes: Reported in final pre-operation construction push in Yanyuan County, Liangshan. Total investment RMB35bn; total IT installed capacity 150MW. Phase 1 RMB8bn, D01 data center plus 220kV substation, 2,500 server cabinets and 500 network cabinets, 30MW IT load and 40,000P compute; phase 2 adds 120MW IT load and 160,000P.

name: 西昌超大型算力项目 (Xichang ultra-large computing power project)
developer: Liangshan/Xichang local authorities and unnamed project investors
notes: China Reform Daily reported an ultra-large computing-power project will land in Xichang; details sparse, so capacity is left null and grade kept at B.

name: 泸州-华为云计算数据中心合作项目
notes: Huawei Cloud news page says Luzhou municipal government and Huawei signed cooperation to jointly build a cloud-computing data center and create intelligent manufacturing, western e-commerce service, provincial information-consumption support, and big-data-processing centers.

name: 眉山天府新区电信枢纽 (Meishan Tianfu New Area Telecom Hub)
developer: China Telecom / Meishan Tianfu New Area partners
notes: China Information News PDF hosted by the National Bureau of Statistics says the telecom hub was completed and put into operation on 2026-01-06 after two years and five months; one of three core computing nodes of the 'Zhiyun Meishan' network, 14.51 mu, RMB100m investment, planned 200 data racks.

name: 环天云智算中心 (Huantian Cloud Intelligent Computing Center)
notes: Same China Information News PDF says Huantian Smart Technology's center is in operation in Meishan Tianfu New Area and has 232 PFLOPS of AI compute.

name: 四川农信视高数据中心项目 (Sichuan Rural Credit Shigao Data Center)
developer: Sichuan Rural Credit Union / project contractors
notes: China Information News PDF says the 92.58 mu Shigao data-center project is in final works and expected to enter operation in Oct. 2026; designed to national Grade A and financial-industry Grade A standards and described as a leading southwest China bank data center.

name: 绵阳云计算中心 (Mianyang Cloud Computing Center)
notes: PR Newswire reported the first phase completed in 2013; jointly invested by Inspur and Mianyang government and operated by Inspur. Modular data center houses 1,000+ high-end servers/storage, provides processing capability equivalent to 5,000+ servers, 2,000 TB design storage and 300 trillion ops compute.

name: 绵阳电信数据中心 / 绵阳电信IDC
notes: Commercial IDC listings describe Mianyang Telecom Data Center as a China Telecom southwest flagship IDC with two operating computer-room facilities at 243 Mianzhou Middle Road, offering colocation/hosting and carrier connectivity. Aggregate/commercial listing, so evidence grade C.

name: 中国（绵阳）科技城数字经济产业园研发实验数据中心
developer: Youxian District / Mianyang Data Bureau / research-institute partners
notes: Sina and Parkworld reported the digital-economy industrial park's phase 2 plan: RMB300m, about 35.89 mu, including R&D offices, an R&D experimental data center, R&D factory, conference center and auxiliary living facilities.
